briefings.title: Prediction Market Betting Stretches Past Sports

people.name: Sean Patrick Maloney
people.role: CEO and President, Coalition for Prediction Markets

briefings.tldr: Prediction markets are expanding rapidly beyond sports and politics into financial indices, offering a transparent, market-driven forecasting tool that the Coalition for Prediction Markets argues should be regulated federally as financial derivatives rather than casinos.
